programs.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship
programs.description: Tuition plus a monthly stipend for financially needy undergraduates at HEC-selected public sector universities. Applications go through the university, not to HEC directly.

application.note: HEC does not announce national dates; each participating university announces its own. Application forms are available through the university financial aid office. No current window is confirmed here.

rules.description: Enrolled or admitted in an undergraduate (4-5 year) program
rules.next_action: Confirm your program is a 4-5 year undergraduate program.

rules.passage: HEC-selected public sector Pakistani universities and degree-awarding institutions
rules.description: Studying at a public sector university
rules.ambiguity: Being public is necessary but not sufficient: only HEC-selected institutions participate.
rules.next_action: Check that your university is on the HEC list of participating institutions.

rules.passage: Those students who secure admission on self-finance are not eligible
rules.description: Not admitted on a self-finance basis
rules.next_action: Check your admission letter for the admission category (merit or self-finance).

unevaluable.description: Financial need, as assessed by your university's scholarship committee
unevaluable.passage: assessed by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee
unevaluable.ambiguity: HEC pages show no national income limit. Some university notices publish their own caps; those are university rules, not HEC rules.
unevaluable.next_action: Ask your university financial aid office which income documents and limit it applies this year.

unevaluable.description: Your university is an HEC-selected participating institution
unevaluable.ambiguity: The introduction page is undated, so the current participating list is not confirmed.
unevaluable.next_action: Check the HEC list of eligible institutions or ask your financial aid office.

programs.name: PEEF Master Level Scholarship
programs.organization: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF), Government of the Punjab
programs.description: PEEF scholarship quota for master's students at partner universities. Applications are submitted to the university, not directly to PEEF.

application.note: PEEF pages reviewed are undated and one refers to the 2025-26 cycle. No current window is confirmed here.

rules.next_action: PEEF has separate programs for other levels; check those if you are not at master's level.

rules.ambiguity: Other PEEF programs mention special quotas for other regions; this rule covers the master's program page only.

rules.passage: at least 60% marks or a minimum CGPA 2.5
rules.description: At least 60% marks or CGPA 2.5 in the bachelor's examination
rules.ambiguity: The page says the qualifying exam must be from the last three years in Punjab; this is not checked here.
rules.next_action: Check your bachelor's result and the exam year and location against the PEEF page.

rules.passage: equal to or less than PKR. 40,000/-
rules.description: Parents' declared monthly income from all sources within the PEEF limit
rules.ambiguity: The official page shows PKR 40,000 with exemptions (children of BPS 1-4 government employees, children of civilians martyred in terrorist attacks), but it is undated and other sites quote different limits.
rules.next_action: Confirm the income limit and your exemption status in the current PEEF notice before relying on this.

rules.passage: Not availing any other educational scholarship
rules.description: Not receiving another educational scholarship this academic year
rules.next_action: List any scholarship or fee support you currently receive.

unevaluable.description: Full-time admission this academic year at a PEEF partner university
unevaluable.passage: Secured admission as a full-time student
unevaluable.ambiguity: The page refers to academic year 2025-26; the current cycle and partner list are not confirmed.
unevaluable.next_action: Ask your university financial aid office whether it is a PEEF partner and for its application deadline.

unevaluable.description: Not in an excluded group (for example marks improvers or supplementary-exam candidates)
unevaluable.passage: Marks improvers or students who have passed examination in supplementary session
unevaluable.next_action: Check the exclusion list on the PEEF page against your own record.
